name: Gie bo
summary: A Bahnar beef broth that Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says began in the highlands of An Khê and Vĩnh Thạnh and is now also eaten in Tây Sơn. The broth is the fresh small intestine, finished sour with lá giang.
origin: Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định addresses it to Phú Phong, Tây Sơn, and says the dish is Bahnar from An Khê and Vĩnh Thạnh.
taste: It names chili, ginger, and lemongrass, sour lá giang, and a slight bitterness if a few drops of bile are added. The portal says that bitterness is the local taste.
howToEat: The bowl comes with fresh noodles, herbs, and toasted sesame rice paper. The broth is brown with a little green.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Phú Phong, Tây Sơn. Not the Quy Nhon beach.
seoTitle: Gie bo — the Tay Son beef broth
seoDescription: Gié bò is a Bahnar beef broth now eaten in Tây Sơn, sour with lá giang, served with noodles and sesame rice paper. A price is Check on arrival.
